# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Godmode is currently a preview. Security fixes are applied to the latest released
version only.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature for this repository when it is
available. Do not open a public issue containing credentials, private repository data,
exploit details, or local continuity records.

Include the affected version, operating system, a minimal reproduction using synthetic
data, expected behavior, observed behavior, and the potential impact. Remove secrets
and identifying project information before submitting the report.

The security model and its explicit host-enforcement boundary are documented in
[GODMODE_SECURITY.md](../GODMODE_SECURITY.md).
